chapters.title: Common pitfalls and the full picture

takeaways: Dataverse security has three layers: security roles for table actions, business units and teams for row access, and field-level security for individual columns.
Privileges are additive, so you cannot restrict a user by adding another role; you must remove the over-permissive role or secure the column.
Always include the Basic User role in custom roles and use field-level security sparingly for truly sensitive columns.
hook: Many Power Platform makers think Dataverse security is about who can open an app, but the real control sits much deeper. This episode explains Dataverse security in plain English for admins and makers. You will learn how security roles, business units, teams and field-level security work together and how to avoid the most common pitfalls.
